title: VibeMatcher
tagline: Find your people. Trade some alpha. Burn some Rizz. Farm some Aura.
description:
🧠 Elevator Pitch
In the wild jungle of crypto events, VibeMatcher is your web3 compass. Whether you're hunting for degens, DAO builders, memelords, or alpha whales, we make sure you connect with the people that actually vibe with your goals—on-chain and IRL.
We tap into on-chain portfolios using the 1inch API and layer in smart tags like “DeFi Degen” or “Infra Maxi” to figure out your professional flavor. Add in event context, and boom—your best matches surface instantly. Built on Polygon, logged in with World ID, and sprinkled with a little gamified magic using our token system: Rizz & Aura.

📜 Description
Let’s be real: networking at huge crypto events feels like yelling into the void. You’re surrounded by potential value, but how do you actually meet the right people?
VibeMatcher solves that. It’s a discovery and connection tool made for crypto folks—devs, traders, meme generals, and DAO crew alike—looking to make meaningful connections based on shared interests, portfolio overlap, and IRL event presence.
🔍 Tag-Based Matching Profiles get tagged with vibes like meme, degen, defi, infra, holder, etc., each with weighted relevance based on on-chain behavior. You can search by filters or let the algorithm work its magic.
🌀 On-Chain Identity Using 1inch API, we pull multi-chain wallet data to create a real-time, decentralized professional profile.
🛂 World ID Login Log in like a citizen of web3. Secure, easy, done.
✨ Tokenized Connections Use $RIZZ to mint Aura NFTs when you meet someone worth remembering. It’s like a follow + clout badge in one—visible on your profile, adding to your "star" status.
🚀 Not Just for Events While it’s perfect for expos, hackathons, and conferences, VibeMatcher also works for low-key hangouts and online-first discovery. Use it anywhere you’re tryna find your next collab or brainwave buddy.
how_its_made:
🛠️ Built With
* 1inch API – Grabs your entire cross-chain wallet vibe to build your digital identity.
* World ID Kit – Zero-friction sign-in. No seed phrase stress, just vibes.
* Polygon – Our chain of choice to keep it cheap, fast, and eco-friendly.
* Custom Matching Algorithm – It’s like Tinder for crypto—but smarter, less cringe.
* Rizz & Aura – $RIZZ powers the platform. Burn it to mint Aura NFTs that show off your network game.
